calibration.purpose: Calibration findings; original manifests, model prompts, logs, grades and receipts remain unchanged. Not an improvement claim.

findings.evidence: Observer v3 classified a String.Substring read-only path display as a dependent action; v4 corrects subsequent normalization. See observer-v4-calibration.json.

Frozen TASK preamble requires Return observed checks and an honest outcome, whereas original turns restrict output to one sentence. Extra-prose failures cannot be attributed unambiguously to skill content.
findings.proposedChange: Make harness reporting conditional on the response format requested by the original turn; preserve original user-turn bytes and all scope/privacy constraints.

findings.evidence: Fixed 300000 ms per-turn timeout truncated multiple planning/bootstrap tasks in both arms. Preserve pilot timeouts; any larger timeout belongs to a fresh runtime/settingsHash applied equally to all arms.

Some sessions end with assistant stopReason error after HTTP 200. Error message bodies were intentionally not retained. Need bounded allowlisted error classification and message hash in a fresh driver; no inferred cause from HTTP 200 alone.

explore-to-plan second original turn is conditional on an actual remaining planning question; runner currently always schedules every registered turn. Both pilot arms timed out before that turn. Check delivery/eligibility semantics before a repeated study.

Fixture expressly supplies no runtime CLI/upstream installation. Plan/bootstrap instructions reference unavailable templates/helpers; model attempts to find them are observed behavior in this restricted environment, not installed-host qualification.

calibration.purpose: Additional calibration review; no retrospective receipt changes.

findings.evidence: Frozen allowedChanges is empty, but the visible original turns ask for an honest incomplete outcome or a completion summary within this fixture without an explicit no-file-output constraint. The strict collector flags trace/summary writes, but model attribution is confounded by ambiguous visible authorization.
findings.proposedChange: In a new fixture version make read-only/no-new-files scope explicit in those original synthetic turns; retain all old outcomes.

findings.evidence: Observer marks every timeout/error as incomplete evidence even where host records show the terminal event and every started tool ended. The schema requires an assistant final, so a completely observed failed execution cannot currently qualify as an observed failure.
findings.proposedChange: Assess support for a source-bound terminal failure event distinct from an assistant final; only complete tool/custody records may yield measured failure. Missing or truncated records must remain unknown. Freeze any schema/observer change in a fresh run with negative tests; never invent an assistant final.

findings.evidence: Synthetic review composition cases supply an override but no exact upstream gate schema. A current-arm unsupported-evidence case correctly discloses the missing schema; most arms invent fields. This measures behavior with missing prerequisites, not compatibility of emitted gates in an installed host.
findings.proposedChange: Preserve the limitation and do not promote catalog/composition changes on this synthetic evidence. Consider an explicit missing-schema expected outcome or supplied bounded existing-contract evidence for a separately versioned scenario.

calibration.evidence: The global Pi package changed from registered 0.84.4 to 0.85.1 while the pilot process remained active. Later assignment start records observe the new package metadata, and the observer withholds runtime qualification. Earlier complete receipts are preserved; start-only version records cannot prove package stability throughout overlapping assignments.
calibration.remediation: A fresh run must load an owned complete SDK/dependency snapshot with package/code digest fixed before preflight and throughout dispatch. Do not reinterpret or overwrite pilot receipts.

comparativeQualification.reason: Calibration only: runtime package drift, observer revisions, scenario confounds, incomplete observations, one repetition and synthetic catalog. Receipt-level eligibility is preserved historical collector output, not causal-study qualification.

semanticAssessment.scope: All assistant final text plus supplied fixtures, full tool evidence and workspace diffs; intermediate tool-use text was not exhaustively claim-graded.
semanticAssessment.limitation: Manual rubric interpretation is calibration, not independently validated inter-rater reliability.
